name: configure_identity_group
description: Safely create or update an internal Vault identity group, validate its ACL policies, preserve existing members, add one entity UUID, and verify the result.

name: fetch_keyvault_metadata
description: Return Azure Key Vault metadata for logging and audit visibility.

name: get_cluster_snapshot
description: Return a JSON snapshot of Vault nodes and health. Includes failed AZs when all nodes in an AZ are unhealthy.

name: get_operator_crds
description: List vault-config-operator CRD kinds suitable for declarative Vault changes.

name: run_vault_api
description: Execute a structured Vault API request; read-only sessions allow only GET and LIST.

name: run_vault_command
description: Run a Vault CLI command inside the admin pod; read-only sessions deny mutations before execution.

name: seal_node
description: Seal the given Vault node by name.

name: suggest_operator_crd
description: Render, but never apply, a vault-config-operator Kubernetes manifest.

name: unseal_node
description: Unseal the given Vault node by name using key shares from the configured recovery store.
